title: helianthemum canum subsp. nebrodense
intro: Helianthemum canum subsp. nebrodense, commonly known as the Sardinian rockrose, is a plant species of the genus Helianthemum. It is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, while its therapeutic actions include antioxidant and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum canum subsp. nebrodense include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
